reason: Both meet the hard requirements, but Response B is more operationally rigorous: it addresses the edge case of snapshotting when the disk is already near-full (snapshot to a separate target), adds a non-destructive write-throttling option while the snapshot is in flight, explicitly gates a primary restart behind snapshot completion plus IC sign-off, and its FOLLOW UP includes post-mitigation data-integrity/checksum verification that A omits despite the incident involving destructive cleanup risk.
